description: Mosaïques d'images satellite is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère des Ressources naturelles et des Forêts. Le lien: Accéder au répertoire de données est disponible à la section Fiches descriptives du jeu de données; Informations complémentaires. Les mosaïques d’images satellite sont des produits conçus en combinant plusieurs tuiles adjacentes d’images satellite du capteur Landsat ou Sentinel. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère des Ressources naturelles et des Forêts. Its tags are Arbre, DIF, Direction inventaires forestiers, Forêt, Imagerie. It offers 11 resource(s) in CSV, ECW, HTML, PDF, WMS. The portal shows 2026-05-25 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
